messages:
nate (product): Heads-up: we're enforcing CA-pinning and tightening cert-rotation rules for Private/on-prem in v3.0. Target rollout: 2026-11-02 (Wave-1). Main items: mandatory CA pin for offline package imports, a 72-hour rotation grace window (agent supports auto-rollover with fallback-key), and a new cert-attestation API for customers using external CAs. Internal notes: https://go/internal/onprem-cert-rotation-v3 (internal). Please run preflight and mark readiness by Mon EOD.

frida (security): Key points: offline imports will require a pinned CA thumbprint in the readiness sheet or the import will be rejected. Export-control: any cert-attestation that involves rotation across jurisdictions needs Legal sign-off. I'll upload the attestation template later today.

omar (eng-release): Tech notes: agent now refuses imports if CA pin mismatch. Preflight snippet for self-hosters:
```
# validate CA pin for agent communication
openssl s_client -connect agent.local:443 -servername agent.local </dev/null 2>/dev/null \
  | openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256
# compare output with expected thumbprint
```
And agent local check: `redwood agent cert-validate --expected-pin=SHA256:AB:CD:...` returns PASS/FAIL. If FAIL, install aborts and agent logs `/var/log/redwood/agent.log`.

lucy (support): We'll add readiness columns: ca_pin_provided, attestation_signed, rotation_contacts. Also adding canned steps for customers to gather thumbprints and how to run the openssl snippet.

diego (sales): Will this affect renewal conversations? Some customers use corporate CAs that rotate monthly.

nate (product): Rotation policy: we allow a 72-hour overlap window where the old key is accepted while new cert propagates. For high-churn CAs customers should use the cert-attestation API so we can automate pin updates. No pricing change, but customers asking for managed rotation can opt into a paid concierge service.

opsbot: rollout-scheduler: Draft rollout created wave-1 start=3410030000 window=10800 owner=@nate id=rollout-341003 :gear:

frida (security): Attestation API quick example (customer self-hosted):
```
# request nonce and sign with external CA key
curl -sS -X POST https://private-admin.internal/customers/CUSTID/cert-attest/request \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"cert_pem":"-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----..."}'
# server returns nonce; customer signs and POSTs back to /cert-attest/confirm
```
Agent will then accept the pinned CA for that customer for 30 days unless renewed. Note: cross-border attestation requires Legal approval.

omar (eng-release): Rollback plan: if any critical failures, toggle enforcement off via feature-flag and allow 24h rollback window. We keep snapshots and package verifications. Preflight command for package import simulation: `redwood pkg verify --simulate --ca-pin SHA256:AB:CD`

lucy (support): We'll schedule an outreach batch to Wave-1 customers with step-by-step verification and the openssl snippet. Also adding a KB article: "How to extract your CA thumbprint".

diego (sales): I'll flag customers with frequent CA rotation and offer the concierge option. Please loop Legal on cross-border attestation requirements.

nate (product): Summary action items: Security - upload attestation template & list of restricted jurisdictions (@frida); Eng-release - add cert-validate and pkg-sim to runbook (@omar); Support - add readiness columns and KB articles, prepare customer outreach (@lucy); Sales - tag rotation-heavy customers and route concierge offers (@diego). React with :white_check_mark: when done. We'll hold GA if any of these items are incomplete by Fri 23:59 UTC. Thanks!
